verdict.rationale: Gumloop's docs say agents can run on scheduled triggers on a recurring basis, not just as a one-time trigger, so the core recurring-schedule capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-expression syntax or a timezone setting for those schedules. missing for 10: cron-style expression support, timezone control for schedules, in-depth scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: Schedule your agent to run automatically on a recurring schedule or as a one-time trigger.
Set up scheduled triggers to run on a recurring or one-time basis
then automate them with triggers, schedules, and the API.
